Description: Hastarii Fusiliers Neutron Laser dice differ. Summary table (page 7): 2 dice (45 cm / 2 / 5+ / −2). Unit card (page 26): 1 die (45 cm / 1 / 5+ / −2). Army list (page 20): 5 bases for 250 (Exterminators are 5 bases for 150).
Sagittarii Mortar range differs. Summary table (page 8): 100 cm (1 / 3+ / −1, Artillery). Unit card (page 30): 75 cm (1 / 3+ / −1).
Vorax Rotor Cannon range differs. Summary table (page 9): 30 cm (3 / 5+ / −1). Unit card (page 38): 20 cm (3 / 5+ / −1).
Archaeopter Fusilave tectomagnetic bombs range column differs. Summary table (page 9): Bombe. Unit card (page 39): 0 cm. Stats otherwise match (1 / 4+ / −2, Bombing (1)).
Note: Tyranids used Bomb for that kind of attack.

Description: Warbringer hull Cerberus Cannon range differs. Summary table (page 13): 60 cm (4 / 4+ / −1, AA). Unit card (page 48): 75 cm (4 / 4+ / −1, AA). The optional carapace Anti-Aircraft Cerberus in the titan weapons table (page 14) is 75 cm for Reaver/Warbringer/Warlord.
Suggestion A: Follow table: 60 cm on the hull gun.
Suggestion B: Follow card: 75 cm on the hull gun.
Note: C: 75 cm everywhere (match the carapace weapon). Print INC on this stat.

Description: Warlord optional banners count differs. Summary table (page 13): 2 Banners and/or 1 Head. Unit card (page 49): 1 Banner option and 1 Head. Reaver is 1 Banner in both. Titan weapons (pages 14–15): Banners and Carapace Multi-Lasers use the Banners slot.

Onager Dunecrawler Icarus Turret is written two ways. Card prose (page 42): all three Onager versions have their weapons on Turret. Summary table (page 10): Phosphor and Graviton guns have Turret; Icarus Array has only AA.
Suggestion A: Follow table: no Turret on the Icarus Array.
Suggestion B: Follow card: Turret on the Icarus Array as well.
Note: AA stays on the Icarus Array in both. Print INC on this stat.

Description: Landing Craft missiles Turret is written two ways. Card (page 46): all weapons are on Turret; missiles also have AA. Summary table (page 12): Howitzers and Heavy Lascannons have Turret; missiles have only AA.
Suggestion A: Follow table: no Turret on the missiles.
Suggestion B: Follow card: Turret on the missiles as well.
Note: AA stays on the missiles in both. Print INC on this stat.

Description: Landing Craft save is 2+ / Fiche on the summary table and card (pages 12, 46), but the hit-location sheet (page 16) only has Warhound/Reaver/Warbringer/Warlord, Fouisseuse, and Ordinatus Majoris.
Suggestion B: Keep Fiche in the profile and leave the missing sheet as a French 3.1.0 gap.

Description: Secutarii Hoplites Dodge (5+) sits in two places. Summary table (page 8): Esquive (5+) on the unit. Card prose (page 30): L'arlance … a les capacités Réduit les Couverts (−3) et Esquive (5+). Rulebook Dodge is a base ability.
Suggestion A: Follow table: Dodge (5+) on the unit.
Suggestion B: Follow card: Dodge (5+) on the Arc Lance.
Note: Reduces Cover (−3) is on the Arc Lance in both.

Description: Skorpius (transport) is on the unit card and army list (pages 21, 43): 25 cm / 4+ / +0 / Attached, Heavy Stubber 30 cm / 2 / 5+ / 0, Transport (2), Attached Transport. It is not in the summary tables (pages 10–11 go from Onager Dunecrawler Scout to Termite). Army-list Options: 2/3/5 bases for +50/75/125.
Suggestion A: Include the card and army-list profile in the English table.
Suggestion B: Leave it out of the summary table.

Description: Fouisseuse Multi-Launchers Tire deux fois par tour is on the summary table (page 12) and missing from the card (page 45). Card does list Turret and Artillery.
Suggestion A: Include fires twice per turn from the table.

Description: Ordinatus Golgotha Hellfire Missiles are Artillery on the card (page 46) and not on the summary table (page 12). Template (12 cm) and Limited Ammunition (6) / 6 per game / max 2 per turn agree.
Ordinatus Armageddon, Golgotha, and Mars hull guns are Canon Lasers Jumelés in the summary table (page 12) and Canons Laser on the cards (pages 45–46). Same stats (60 cm / 4 / 4+ / −1).

Off-table Laser Lance abilities are on the summary table (page 13): Damage +1D3 and Off-Table Artillery. Card (page 49) prints the profile line but only describes Fragmentation Barrage and Macro Barrage in prose.
Suggestion A: Include Damage +1D3 and Off-Table Artillery from the table.
Suggestion B: Print the profile with no extra abilities (match the omitted prose).

Description: Onager Dunecrawler Scout Autocannon Tourelle is on the Autocannon in the summary table (page 10) and not mentioned on the card (page 42). Card puts Turret on both Eradicator modes only.
Suggestion A: Turret on the Autocannon as well (table).
Suggestion B: Turret only on the Eradicator modes (card).

Description: Fouisseuse Sortie de Fouisseuse is a weapon row in the summary table (page 12): 0 cm / Template / 3+ / −1, Template (12 cm). Card and special-ability text (pages 6, 45) put the named ability on the unit when the tunneler surfaces (same 12 cm / 3+ / AP −1).
Suggestion B: keep the template stats from the special rule and table.
Note: Keep it as a weapon row only.
Chosen: Special-rules text describes a surfacing effect.

Description: Landing Craft howitzer name. Table (page 12): Obusiers (45 cm / 4 / 4+ / −2, Turret). Card (page 46): Obusiers Gauche, same stats.
Suggestion B: Keep Left Howitzers on the card.

Description: Thanatar Calix Graviton and Damages Buildings (AP −3/1) are on the Grav Ram in the summary table (page 9). Card (page 38): son arme (singular) has those abilities, and the profile also has a Lascannon.
Suggestion B: On both weapons or on the unit.

Description: Conversion Beam used-by cell (page 15): DW, R, W. Footer is D = Warhound, R = Reaver/Warbringer, W = Warlord.
Suggestion B: Keep DW as a fourth class.

Description: Carapace landing module name is mashed in the titan weapons table (page 15): Moduled’Atterrissage Carapace. Extracted text and the ability name: Module d’Atterrissage de Carapace / Land Speeder de Reconnaissance.

Devotion Bell is Cloche de Dévotion in the special-ability text (page 5) and Cloche de la Dévotion in the titan weapons table (page 14). Same 50-point Warlord carapace option with Charismatic (30 cm).
One-Use is Usage Unique on most titan weapons (pages 14–15) and Usage unique on Missile Vortex and Missile Warp.
Domitar heading is ROBOT DOMINATAR (page 37). Table, army list, and card body (pages 9, 22, 37): Domitar.
Ursarax heading is URSURAX (page 32). Table, army list, and card body (pages 8, 22, 32): Ursarax.
Serberys is Serbery in the summary table and card title (pages 8, 33) and Serberys in the army list and card lore (pages 19–20, 33).
Suggestion B: Keep Serbery on the table and card title.

Description: Skitarii Pilgrim is Pelerin in the table, army list, and card title (pages 7, 22, 29) and Pellerin / Pelerins in the card lore (page 29).
Thanatar Calix is Callix in the card ability line (page 38). Table, heading, army list, and lore (pages 9, 22, 38): Calix.
Phosphor is Phospore on the Archaeopter Stratoraptor (pages 10, 39): Blaster au Phospore. Rest of the book: Phosphore (Pteraxii, Serberys, Onager).

Eradicator is written Erradicateur and Eradicateur. Summary table (page 10): Rayon Erradicateur / R. Eradicateur. Card (page 42): Rayon Eradicateur. Titan weapons (pages 14–15): Erradicateur à Graviton / Volkite. Hastarii: Projecteur d’Eradication.
Ordinatus Minoris Graviton main gun is Detructeur à Graviton in the summary table and card profile (pages 11, 44) and Destructeur à Graviton in the card prose (page 44).
Suggestion B: Keep Detructeur on the profile line.

Description: Robot company contents cell (page 18): 1 socle de Magos Dominus sur Abeyantagos. Name row and rest of the book: Magos Dominus sur Abeyant.
Ironstrider Ballistarii is Ferro-Échassier Ballistarii (singular) in the summary table (page 8) and Ferro-Échassiers Ballistarii in the army list and card heading (pages 19, 21, 35).
Suggestion B: Keep the singular on the table.

Description: Ordinatus Golgotha missiles are Missiles Hellfire in the summary table (page 12) and Missiles Feu d’Enfer on the card (page 46). Same stats.
Suggestion B: Keep Feu d’Enfer on the card.

Description: HQ graviton sidearm is Pistolet Graviton on tables and card profiles and Pistolet à Graviton in card ability lines (pages 7–8, 25, 27, 32).
Macrocarid Explorator main gun is Canon Laser L Jumelés in the summary table (page 10) and Canon Laser Lourd Jumelés on the card (page 41). Same stats (60 cm / 2 / 4+ / −2).
Terrier emergence is Sortie Fouisseuse in the special-ability heading (page 6) and Sortie de Fouisseuse on the table and card (pages 12, 45).
Suggestion A: One English name: Hellbore Emergence (or equivalent).

Description: Ordinatus Minoris Quake Cannon building rule is Endommage les Bâtiments (PA −4/3) in the summary table (page 11) and Détruit les Bâtiments (PA −4/3) in the card prose (page 44). Same numbers.
Suggestion B: Keep Destroys Buildings on that sentence.

Description: Castellan lore names power gauntlets that are not on the profile. Card lore (page 36): Gantelets Énergétiques. Summary table and card profile (pages 9, 36): Flamer only.
Suggestion A: Follow table and card profile: Flamer.
Suggestion B: Add power gauntlets from the lore.
Note: Table and card stats already agree.

Description: Colossus lore names a siege hammer that is not on the profile. Card lore (page 37): marteau de siège with lighter guns. Summary table and card profile (pages 9, 37): Multi-melta only
Suggestion A: Damages Buildings (AP −2/1) in assault on the unit.
Suggestion B: Follow table and card profile: Multi-melta.
Note: Add a siege hammer from the lore.
Chosen: Table and card stats already agree.

Description: Thanatar Calix lore names a Sollex Heavy Lascannon as the main gun (page 38). Summary table and card profile (pages 9, 38): Grav Ram and Lascannon.
Suggestion A: Follow table and card profile: Grav Ram and Lascannon.
Suggestion B: Replace with Sollex Heavy Lascannon from the lore.
Note: Table and card stats already agree.

Description: Karacnos lore names Hunter-Killer missiles (page 40). Summary table and card profile (pages 10, 40): Radiation Mortar and Lascannon only
Suggestion B: Follow table and card profile: no Hunter-Killers.
Chosen: Table and card stats already agree.

Description: Krios lore names interlocking energy fields (page 40) and the Venator lore calls the Krios gun Canon à Foudre (page 41). Summary table and both profiles (pages 10, 40–41): Electro-Cannon / Pulsar-Fusil
Chosen: Table and card stats already agree.

Description: Termite lore names fusion cutters (page 43). Summary table and card profile (pages 11, 43): Autocannon.
Suggestion A: Follow table and card profile: Autocannon.
Suggestion B: Add fusion cutters from the lore.
Note: Table and card stats already agree.

Description: Onager Dunecrawler lore (page 42) lists Canon Rayon Icarus twice and omits the Phosphor Blaster variant. Summary table and card profiles (pages 10, 42) have three versions: Heavy Phosphor Blaster, Heavy Grav-Cannon, Icarus Array.
Suggestion A: Follow table and card profiles: three versions.

Suggestion A: Electro-Priests line whose contents are 1 Ordinatus Mars). Summary tables, cards, and the real list (pages 7–22, 25–49) are the sources.
Suggestion B: Follow the real army list and profiles.
